comment: 原文（GCN 20131）：'UVOT took a finding chart exposure of 150 seconds with the White filter starting 586 seconds after the BAT trigger. No credible afterglow candidate has been found in the initial data products. ... The typical 3-sigma upper limit has been about 19.6 mag.'。窗口 T+586→T+736，中点 time=661.0、time_err=150/2=75.0（§3.8；原行 time=544 锚在误取的旧 T0=04:53:44（MASTER 指向时刻）且取曝光起点，已修正）；band=w 改 uvot-white（w 为 Pan-STARRS 键，两车道规则）；mag_system=Vega（UVOT 光度系统 Breeveld+2011 惯例推定，GCN 20157 明示）；同一 FC 曝光 GCN 20157 white(fc) 586–735 s、147 s 曝光给 >20.44，为免同曝重复不另立行，记于此；'8'x8' region typically complete to about 18 mag' 为覆盖性表述不入行（§3.5）；未做消光改正（GCN 20131 E(B−V)=0.32）

原文（GCN 20133）：MASTER II（IAC）指向 2016-11-05 04:53:44 UT=T+42（'42 sec after trigger time'），首组 10 s 曝光 'The 5-sigma upper limit has been about 16.4 mag (polaroid, unfiltered)'（SWIFT error-box ra=120.163 dec=−44.7794 r=0.05 即 BAT on-board）。time=42+10/2=47.0、time_err=10/2=5.0（§3.8）；原文 (polaroid, unfiltered) 未滤光 → band=G、mag_system 留空（§3.4）；'Maximal coadded limit ~19.5 m. No OT found.' 无时间窗锚定不入行，记于此

原文（GCN 20152）：TAROT La Silla（D=25cm）于 T+27.4 s 开始观测（'observations started 27.4s after the GRB trigger'），首帧 60 s 拖尾像 't0+27.4s to t0+87.4s : Rlim = 16.5'（XRT error box 内无 OT）。中点 time=57.4、半跨 time_err=30.0（§3.8）；band=R；星等以就近 NOMAD1 恒星定标、原文明言未做银消改正且未声明星等系统 → mag_system 留空（§3.4）；观测始时场仰角 31°、天气良好备查

原文（GCN 20152）：'t0+743.2s to t0+833.2s : Rlim = 19.8'（90 s 曝光，第二帧因技术问题延至 T+743.2）。中点 time=788.2、半跨 time_err=45.0（§3.8）；band=R；NOMAD1 定标未声明星等系统 → mag_system 留空；未做银消改正；'No more candidate were found in the next images taken until 2000 seconds after the GRB at the same limiting magnitude' 为覆盖性表述、无单一锚点/深度对不入行（§3.5），记于此
